pharmakon-insight-2-q8.onnx is Pharmakon's own encoder for Insight (2026-11-19). It is a modified version of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, which is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0; LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt in this folder). Copyright of the original: the Sentence-Transformers authors (Nils Reimers, Iryna Gurevych) and the authors of the underlying MiniLM model (Microsoft).

Changes made by Pharmakon (Apache-2.0, section 4b): the original float weights were trained further on Pharmakon's own examples only (the ways people ask each answer of the site, written by the site's readers and its editor from the site's own questions; and near-miss questions an answer does not answer): scripts/insight/train.py --base minilm --teacher --all --epochs 6 (every answer of the site on 19 November 2026; the readers' wordings, the near-miss readers' and the editor's 3,001 teachers' wordings), averaged half and half with the original weights (--mix 0.5); and written as an int8 ONNX file with the same inputs and output as the original. It uses the original vocabulary (vocab.txt, unmodified). Pharmakon's changes are released under the same licence.

sha256(pharmakon-insight-2-q8.onnx) = 69471fc569769d85debac8f3f52e64db59fbdd63e2fde3db8b9a02ceacedf850
